parameters.query:
insert into message_log (message_id, conversation_id, contact_id, body, status)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'processing')
on conflict (message_id) do update set status = 'processing', error = null
  where message_log.status = 'failed'
     or (message_log.status = 'processing' and message_log.received_at < now() - interval '10 minutes')
returning message_id, reply_sent_at,
  (select extract(epoch from b.start_time) * 1000 from bookings b where b.message_id = $1 limit 1) as booked_start

parameters.query:
update message_log set intent = $2, tier = $3, score = $4, next_action = $5, reply = $6, articles = $7::text[],
  model = $8, used_fallback = $9, error = nullif($10, ''), input_tokens = $11, output_tokens = $12,
  cost_usd = $13, latency_ms = $14, status = 'done'
where message_id = $1
returning message_id

with mine as (select event_id from bookings where message_id = $1 limit 1),
ins as (
  insert into bookings (calendar_id, contact_id, conversation_id, message_id, start_time, end_time)
  select $2, $3, $4, $1, $5::timestamptz, $5::timestamptz + interval '2 hours'
  where not exists (select 1 from mine)
  on conflict (calendar_id, start_time) do nothing
  returning 1
)
select (select event_id from mine) as existing_event,
  exists (select 1 from mine) or exists (select 1 from ins) as reserved
delete from bookings where message_id = $1 and event_id is null
update message_log set reply_sent_at = now() where message_id = $1
